diagnosis: The legal review gateway forwards client-provided X-Firm-Key headers directly to the downstream ArchiveVaultFeignClient without checking if the key belongs to the authenticated attorney's law firm. Attorneys can pass competitor law firm keys in request headers to download sealed case dossiers and confidential settlement drafts.
